# Physities

> Python library for representing and working with physical quantities and units. Provides dimensional analysis, unit conversion, and mathematical operations.

Physities uses a three-layer architecture: BaseDimension (7 SI dimensions) -> Dimension (composite dimensions) -> Scale (conversion factors) -> Unit (values with scales). The MetaUnit metaclass enables class-level operator overloading for elegant syntax like `Meter / Second`.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/README.md): Installation and usage guide
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Development guide for AI assistants

## Source

- [Unit](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/physities/src/unit/unit.py): Core Unit and MetaUnit classes
- [Scale](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/physities/src/scale/scale.py): Scale class for unit conversion
- [Dimension](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/physities/src/dimension/dimension.py): Dimension class
- [Pre-defined Units](https://github.com/CenturyBoys/physities/blob/main/physities/src/unit/__init__.py): All available units
